rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit from the physician (who made the diagnosis or follows clinically) no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 2. Imaging (MRA or CTA) of major vascular systems performed within the previous two (2) years. Submit reports for images of:
  • Brain;
  • Head and neck;
  • Coronary arteries (CTA); and
  • Abdomen and pelvis to include iliac arteries.
  • 3. Other testing: Copies of any other testing already performed by the treating physician.
